title: Needs an update
body:
The reminders app works fine: it is stable and allows to share lists with others. Two mandatory features for me. However, it feels “uncomfortable” to use: there are a lot of things that could be automated to help speed up working with the app, even before we start mentioning AI.
I guess it’s just one of those apps , delivered with the OS that doesn’t get the required attention.

title: Healthy Reminders
body:
Reminders are a great way to help us in our daily routines

• We can set positive reminders to stay happy
• We can set reminders to push ourselves towards our goals
• We can set reminders to stay kind to ourselves and others
• We can set reminders to be patient and to take our own time on tasks.

Use Reminders wisely to enhance your daily workflow and to become a more happy version of yourself. 

#StayPositive #Inspiration #BeYourself #JoinMyJourney🧿 #MelsMind  #BreakYourPattern
